description:
Please join and help Representative Farooq Mughal in his re-election campaign

Contributions may be made online or by check at the event for Mughal for Georgia.

Honorable Georgia State Representative Farooq Mughal proudly represents the people of Georgia’s 105th District. Mr. Mughal is one of the top rising star lawmakers in the State of Georgia. In his first legislative term, Governor Brian Kemp signed Mr. Mughal’s ten co-sponsored legislation into law; focusing on veterans, criminal justice reform, filling our critical workforce shortages, law enforcement, and small business owners. He received an A+ ranking from the Georgia Chamber.

Paid by Mughal for Georgia, LLC
